```python
import hamana

# Connect to in-memory database
hamana.connect()

# Execute a raw SQL statement
hamana.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
hamana.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES (1, 'Alice')")
hamana.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES (2, 'Bob')")

# Execute a query and retrieve results
result = hamana.query("SELECT * FROM users")
print(result)

# Disconnect
hamana.disconnect()
```
